intro.en: A son asks his father about the two Eids in Islam: when they come, and what we do. We also learn about Zakat al-Fitr, which is given to the poor.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein beta apne abu se Islam ki do Eidon ke baare mein poochhta hai: woh kab aati hain aur hum kya karte hain. Hum Zakat-ul-Fitr ke baare mein bhi seekhenge jo gharibon ko di jati hai.
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ اِبْنٌ أَباهُ عَنِ العيدَيْنِ في الإِسْلامِ: مَتى يَأْتِيانِ وَماذا نَفْعَلُ فيهِما. وَنَتَعَلَّمُ أَيْضًا عَنْ زَكاةِ الفِطْرِ الَّتي تُعْطى لِلْفُقَراءِ.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ عيداً في الإسْلامِ يا أَبي؟
dialogue.en: How many Eids are there in Islam, father?
dialogue.ur: Islam mein kitni Eidein hain, abu?

dialogue.ar: في الإسْلامِ عيدانِ: عيدُ الفِطْرِ، وَعيدُ الأَضْحى.
dialogue.en: There are two Eids: Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha.
dialogue.ur: Islam mein do Eidein hain: Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Azha.

dialogue.en: When is Eid al-Fitr?
dialogue.ur: Eid-ul-Fitr kab hoti hai?

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضان؛ في اليَوْمِ الأَوَّلِ مِنْ شَوّال.
dialogue.tr: baʿda shahri ramaḍān; fil-yawmil-awwali min shawwāl
dialogue.en: After Ramadan, on the first day of Shawwal.
dialogue.ur: Ramazan ke baad, Shawwal ki pehli tareekh ko.

dialogue.en: What do we do on Eid day?
dialogue.ur: Eid ke din hum kya karte hain?

dialogue.en: We give Zakat al-Fitr to the poor.
dialogue.ur: Hum gharibon ko Zakat-ul-Fitr dete hain.

dialogue.en: And what is Zakat al-Fitr?
dialogue.ur: Aur Zakat-ul-Fitr kya hai?

dialogue.ar: صاعٌ مِنْ طَعامٍ عَنْ كُلِّ شَخْص.
dialogue.tr: ṣāʿun min ṭaʿāmin ʿan kulli shakhṣ
dialogue.en: A saa' of food for every person.
dialogue.ur: Har shakhs ki taraf se aik saa' khana.

dialogue.en: And what do we do after that?
dialogue.ur: Aur uske baad hum kya karte hain?

dialogue.ar: نُصَلّي صَلاةَ العيدِ، وَنَزورُ الأَهْلَ وَالأَصْدِقاء.
dialogue.en: We pray the Eid prayer and visit family and friends.
dialogue.ur: Hum Eid ki namaz parhte hain aur rishtedaron aur doston se milte hain.

dialogue.en: And when is Eid al-Adha?
dialogue.ur: Aur Eid-ul-Azha kab hoti hai?

dialogue.ar: في اليَوْمِ العاشِرِ مِنْ ذي الحِجَّة.
dialogue.en: On the tenth day of Dhul-Hijjah.
dialogue.ur: Zil-Hijjah ki dasvin tareekh ko.

dialogue.en: And what do we do on Eid al-Adha?
dialogue.ur: Aur Eid-ul-Azha par hum kya karte hain?

dialogue.ar: نُصَلّي صَلاةَ العيدِ، وَنَذْبَحُ الأُضْحِيَّةَ، وَنَزورُ الأَهْلَ وَالأَصْدِقاء.
dialogue.tr: nuṣallī ṣalātal-ʿīd, wa nadhbaḥul-uḍḥiyya, wa nazūrul-ahla wal-aṣdiqāʾ
dialogue.en: We pray, sacrifice the animal, and visit family and friends.
dialogue.ur: Hum namaz parhte hain, qurbani karte hain aur rishtedaron aur doston se milte hain.

q.en: How many Eids are there in Islam?

options: في اليَوْمِ العاشِرِ مِنْ ذي الحِجَّة
صاعٌ مِنْ طَعامٍ عَنْ كُلِّ شَخْص

q.ur: Zakat-ul-Fitr kis ko di jati hai?

options: في اليَوْمِ العاشِرِ مِنْ ذي الحِجَّة

intro.en: Ahmad and his father talk about a holiday trip to Egypt. They choose how to travel: by air or by sea, and how many days to stay.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Ahmad aur uske abu chhutti mein Misr ke safar ki baat karte hain. Woh sochte hain ke hawai jahaz se jayein ya samundar ke raaste, aur kitne din rahein.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ أَحْمَدُ وَأَبوهُ عَنْ رِحْلَةِ العُطْلَةِ إِلى مِصْرَ. يَخْتارانِ طَريقَةَ السَّفَرِ، بِالجَوِّ أَوْ بِالبَحْرِ، وَعَدَدَ الأَيّامِ.

dialogue.en: The holiday is near, father.
dialogue.ur: Chhutti qareeb aa gayi hai, abu.

dialogue.ar: ما رَأْيُكَ يا نَدى؟ إِلى أَيْنَ نُسافِرُ؟
dialogue.tr: mā raʾyuki yā nadā? ilā ayna nusāfir?
dialogue.en: What do you think, Nada? Where shall we travel?
dialogue.ur: Aap ki kya raye hai, Nada? Hum kahan jayein?

dialogue.en: I have an idea: we travel to Egypt.
dialogue.ur: Meri aik raye hai: Misr jayein.

dialogue.en: Why do we travel to Egypt?
dialogue.ur: Hum Misr kyun jayein?

dialogue.en: To see Egypt and the Nile.
dialogue.ur: Taake Misr aur darya-e-Neel dekhein.

dialogue.en: Agreed, a good idea.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe manzoor hai, achhi raye hai.

dialogue.en: How do we travel to Egypt?
dialogue.ur: Hum Misr kaise jayein?

dialogue.en: We travel by air.
dialogue.ur: Hum hawai jahaz se jayein.

dialogue.en: Travel by air is expensive.
dialogue.ur: Hawai safar mehnga hai.

dialogue.ar: إِذَنْ نُسافِرُ بِالبَحْرِ. السَّفَرُ بِالبَحْرِ رَخيصٌ.
dialogue.tr: idhan nusāfiru bil-baḥr. as-safaru bil-baḥri rakhīṣ
dialogue.en: Then we travel by sea. Travel by sea is cheap.
dialogue.ur: To phir samundar se jayein. Samundari safar sasta hai.

dialogue.en: How many days will we spend in Egypt?
dialogue.ur: Hum Misr mein kitne din guzarenge?

dialogue.en: Seven days.
dialogue.ur: Saat din.

dialogue.ar: سَبْعَةَ أَيّام... جَميلٌ! نُسافِرُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ إِنْ شاءَ الله.
dialogue.tr: sabʿata ayyām... jamīl! nusāfiru yawmas-sabt in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: Seven days... lovely! We travel on Saturday, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Saat din... khoob! Hum Hafte ke din jayein ge, insha'Allah.

dialogue.en: Thank you, father.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya abu.

q.en: How does the father describe travel by air?
q.ur: Abu hawai safar ko kaisa kehte hain?

q.en: What is cheaper, according to Ahmad?
q.ur: Ahmad ke mutabiq kya sasta hai?

q.en: How many days will they spend in Egypt?
q.ur: Woh Misr mein kitne din guzarenge?

title.en: Dialogue 3: Where will you spend the holiday?

intro.en: A teacher asks five students where they will spend the summer holiday. Each one has a different plan. Notice the future with «سَـ» (sa-): سَأَقْضي means "I will spend".
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ustaad paanch talib-ilmon se poochhte hain ke woh gharmiyon ki chhutti kahan guzarenge. Har aik ka mansooba alag hai. Dhyan dein: «سَـ» (sa-) mustaqbil ke liye aata hai: سَأَقْضي ka matlab "main guzaroonga".
intro.ar: تَسْأَلُ المُعَلِّمَةُ خَمْسَةَ طُلّابٍ: أَيْنَ سَتَقْضونَ عُطْلَةَ الصَّيْفِ؟ لِكُلٍّ مِنْهُمْ خُطَّةٌ. لاحِظِ المُسْتَقْبَلَ بِـ«سَـ»: سَأَقْضي.

dialogue.ar: أَيْنَ سَتَقْضونَ عُطْلَةَ الصَّيْفِ يا طُلّاب؟ إِلى أَيْنَ سَتَذْهَبُ أَنْتَ؟
dialogue.tr: ayna sataqḍūna ʿuṭlatas-ṣayfi yā ṭullāb? ilā ayna satadhhabu anta?
dialogue.en: Where will you spend the summer holiday, students? Where will you go?
dialogue.ur: Bachon, aap gharmiyon ki chhutti kahan guzarenge? Aap kahan jayenge?

dialogue.ar: سَأَقْضي عُطْلَةَ الصَّيْفِ في القَرْيَةِ مَعَ جَدّي. المَكانُ هُناكَ هادِئٌ، وَالهَواءُ نَقِيٌّ.
dialogue.tr: sa-aqḍī ʿuṭlatas-ṣayfi fil-qarya maʿa jaddī. al-makānu hunāka hādiʾ, wal-hawāʾu naqiyy
dialogue.en: I will spend it in the village with my grandfather. The place is quiet and the air is clean.
dialogue.ur: Main gaon mein apne dada ke saath guzaroonga. Wahan jagah khamosh aur hawa saaf hai.

dialogue.ar: سَأَقْضي عُطْلَةَ الصَّيْفِ في العاصِمَةِ مَعَ عَمّي؛ سَأَزورُ المَكْتَباتِ وَالمَتاحِف.
dialogue.tr: sa-aqḍī ʿuṭlatas-ṣayfi fil-ʿāṣima maʿa ʿammī; sa-azūrul-maktabāti wal-matāḥif
dialogue.en: In the capital with my uncle; I will visit libraries and museums.
dialogue.ur: Dar-ul-hukumat mein apne chacha ke saath; main maktabon aur museum dekhoon ga.

dialogue.ar: سَأَقْضي عُطْلَةَ الصَّيْفِ بَيْنَ الجِبالِ مَعَ فَريقِ الجَوّالَة.
dialogue.en: Among the mountains with the scout team.
dialogue.ur: Pahadon ke beech scout team ke saath.

dialogue.ar: سَأَقْضي العُطْلَةَ في مَكَّةَ وَالمَدينَةِ مَعَ أُسْرَتي: سَنَعْتَمِرُ وَنَحُجُّ، وَنَزورُ المَسْجِدَ النَّبَوِيَّ.
dialogue.tr: sa-aqḍil-ʿuṭla fī makkata wal-madīna maʿa usratī: sa-naʿtamiru wa naḥujj, wa nazūrul-masjidan-nabawiyy
dialogue.en: In Makkah and Madinah with my family: we will do Umrah and Hajj and visit the Prophet's Mosque.
dialogue.ur: Makkah aur Madinah mein apne ghar walon ke saath: umrah aur hajj karenge aur Masjid-e-Nabawi ki ziyarat karenge.

dialogue.ar: سَأَقْضي العُطْلَةَ في بَلَدي. سَأُساعِدُ والِدي في المَزْرَعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: sa-aqḍil-ʿuṭla fī baladī. sa-usāʿidu wālidī fil-mazraʿa
dialogue.en: In my own country. I will help my father on the farm.
dialogue.ur: Apne watan mein. Main farm mein apne walid ki madad karoonga.

dialogue.en: Happy holiday, students.
dialogue.ur: Chhutti mubarak ho, bachon.

dialogue.en: Happy holiday, teacher.
dialogue.ur: Aap ko bhi chhutti mubarak, ustaad.

q.en: Where will the first student spend the holiday?
q.ur: Pehla talib-ilm chhutti kahan guzaray ga?

q.en: Who will visit libraries and museums?
q.ur: Maktabon aur museum kaun jaye ga?

q.en: The third student will spend the holiday among the...
q.ur: Teesra talib-ilm chhutti kin ke beech guzaray ga?
q.ar: بَيْنَ ماذا سَيَقْضي الطّالِبُ الثّالِثُ العُطْلَةَ؟

q.en: Who will help his father on the farm?
q.ur: Apne walid ki farm mein kaun madad karega?

intro.en: Practice with the Arabic (Hijri) months: arrange them in order, and say which month comes before or after another. The months start with Muharram and end with Dhul-Hijjah.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum Arabi (Hijri) mahinon ki mashq karte hain: unhein tarteeb se likhna aur yeh batana ke kaun sa mahina kis se pehle ya baad aata hai. Mahine Muharram se shuru aur Zil-Hijjah par khatam hote hain.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الشُّهورِ العَرَبِيَّةِ (الهِجْرِيَّةِ): رَتِّبْها، وَقُلْ أَيُّ شَهْرٍ قَبْلَ شَهْرٍ آخَرَ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ. تَبْدَأُ الشُّهورُ بِالمُحَرَّمِ وَتَنْتَهي بِذي الحِجَّةِ.

q.en: What is the first Arabic month?
q.ur: Pehla Arabi mahina kaun sa hai?

q.en: What is the last Arabic month?
q.ur: Aakhri Arabi mahina kaun sa hai?
Ramazan se pehle kaun sa mahina hai?

q.en: In which month do Muslims fast?
q.ur: Musalman kis mahine mein roza rakhte hain?

q.en: Eid al-Fitr is in the month of...

intro.en: Practice what you learned: answer questions about Eid, Zakat al-Fitr and the family trip, and match words to make expressions like «عيدُ الفِطْر» and «صَلاةُ العيد».
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum ne jo seekha uski mashq hai: Eid, Zakat-ul-Fitr aur ghar walon ke safar ke sawalon ke jawab dena, aur lafzon ko jod kar jumle banana jaise «عيدُ الفِطْر» aur «صَلاةُ العيد».
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى ما تَعَلَّمْتَ: أَجِبْ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةٍ حَوْلَ العيدِ وَزَكاةِ الفِطْرِ وَرِحْلَةِ الأُسْرَةِ، وَطابِقِ الكَلِماتِ لِتُكَوِّنَ عِباراتٍ مِثْلَ «عيدُ الفِطْرِ» وَ«صَلاةُ العيدِ».

q.en: Complete: ____ الفِطْر (the festival of breaking the fast)

q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ هِيَ الصَّلاةُ الَّتي نُؤَدّيها يَوْمَ العيدِ؟
أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى الإِجازَةِ في فَصْلِ الصَّيْفِ؟

intro.en: The letters of Arabic are two kinds. With «الـ», the moon letters keep the «ل» clear (القَمَر), but with the sun letters the «ل» is silent and the next letter is doubled (الشَّمْس). We also listen to a short text about summer holidays.
intro.ur: Arabi ke huroof do qism ke hain. «الـ» ke saath qamari huroof mein «ل» saaf parha jata hai (القَمَر), lekin shamsi huroof mein «ل» nahi parha jata aur agla harf dohra ho jata hai (الشَّمْس). Hum gharmiyon ki chhuttiyon par aik chhota matan bhi sunte hain.
intro.ar: حُروفُ العَرَبِيَّةِ مَعَ «الـ» نَوْعانِ: القَمَرِيَّةُ تَظْهَرُ فيها اللّامُ كَما في «القَمَر»، وَالشَّمْسِيَّةُ تَسْكُتُ فيها اللّامُ وَيُشَدَّدُ الحَرْفُ التّالي كَما في «الشَّمْس». ثُمَّ نَسْتَمِعُ إِلى نَصٍّ قَصيرٍ عَنْ عُطْلَةِ الصَّيْفِ.

q.en: Which word starts with a sun letter?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz shamsi harf se shuru hota hai?

q.en: Which word starts with a moon letter?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz qamari harf se shuru hota hai?

q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الحُروفِ شَمْسِيٌّ؟

title.ur: Guftagu: Aap kaise safar karte hain?

intro.en: Practice speaking with a partner: ask how your friend travels to a country (by plane, by ship, by car, by train) and answer using the same pattern.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum apne saathi ke saath guftagu ki mashq karte hain: poochhein ke woh kisi mulk tak kaise safar karta hai (jahaz, kashti, gaari, rail) aur usi andaz mein jawab dein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَلى الكَلامِ: اسْأَلْهُ كَيْفَ يُسافِرُ إِلى بَلَدٍ (بِالطّائِرَةِ، بِالسَّفينَةِ، بِالسَّيّارَةِ، بِالقِطارِ) وَأَجِبْ بِالتَّرْكيبِ نَفْسِهِ.

q.en: How do you ask "How do you travel to Egypt?"
q.ur: "Aap Misr kaise jate hain?" kaise poochhein?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ صَديقَكَ عَنْ طَريقَةِ سَفَرِهِ إِلى مِصْرَ؟
أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني وَسيلَةَ سَفَرٍ في الجَوِّ؟
أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني وَسيلَةً تَسيرُ عَلى السِّكَّةِ الحَديدِيَّةِ؟

q.ur: «كَمْ يَوْماً سَتَقْضي؟» kis ke baare mein hai?

intro.en: Read a passage about who will do what in the summer: Ahmad helps his father on the farm, Ali goes to Makkah and Madinah, and Umar travels to Egypt. Then answer questions about the text.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein aik matan parhein ke gharmiyon mein kaun kya karega: Ahmad farm mein walid ki madad karega, Ali Makkah aur Madinah jaye ga, aur Umar Misr jaye ga. Phir matan ke sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: اِقْرَأْ نَصًّا عَمَّنْ سَيَفْعَلُ ماذا في الصَّيْفِ: أَحْمَدُ يُساعِدُ أَباهُ في المَزْرَعَةِ، وَعَلِيٌّ يَذْهَبُ إِلى مَكَّةَ وَالمَدينَةِ، وَعُمَرُ يُسافِرُ إِلى مِصْرَ. ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ النَّصِّ.

q.en: Who will travel to Saudi Arabia?
Who will help his father on the farm?
q.ur: Farm mein walid ki madad kaun karega?
Umar ka khandaan kaise safar karega?

q.en: The student travelled to Egypt to study...
q.ur: Talib-ilm Misr mein kya parhne gaya?
q.ar: ماذا سافَرَ الطّالِبُ إِلى مِصْرَ لِيَدْرُسَ؟

intro.en: Review words and phrases from the unit: festivals, farm, mountains, rivers, seas and museums, and sentence patterns with «كَمْ», «أَيْنَ», «مَتى» and «لِماذا».
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum is unit ke alfaaz aur jumle dohrate hain: tehwaar, farm, pahad, darya, samundar aur museum, aur «كَمْ», «أَيْنَ», «مَتى» aur «لِماذا» wale jumle.
intro.ar: راجِعْ كَلِماتِ الوِحْدَةِ وَعِباراتِها: الأَعْيادُ، وَالمَزْرَعَةُ، وَالجِبالُ، وَالأَنْهارُ، وَالبِحارُ، وَالمَتاحِفُ، وَتَراكيبُ «كَمْ» وَ«أَيْنَ» وَ«مَتى» وَ«لِماذا».

vocab.ur: hum rishtedaron aur doston se milte hain

q.en: When is Eid al-Adha? (use the pattern «مَتى»)
q.ar: أَجِبْ عَنْ سُؤالِ «مَتى»: مَتى عيدُ الأَضْحى؟

options: في اليَوْمِ العاشِرِ مِنْ ذي الحِجَّة

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَكانًا تُعْرَضُ فيهِ الآثارُ القَديمَةُ؟

intro.en: A review test on the last two units: vocabulary, singular and plural, opposites, and short sentences.
intro.ur: Pichhle do unit ka jaiza: alfaaz, wahid aur jama, ulte alfaaz aur chhote jumle.
intro.ar: اخْتِبارُ مُراجَعَةٍ عَلى الوِحْدَتَيْنِ الأَخيرَتَيْنِ: المُفْرَداتُ، وَالمُفْرَدُ وَالجَمْعُ، وَالأَضْدادُ، وَالجُمَلُ القَصيرَةُ.

intro.en: The final exam for the whole of Book 1: listening and understanding, vocabulary, singular and plural, opposites, verbs, sentences and writing. Take your time. Well done on reaching the end of Book 1!
intro.ur: Pori Kitaab 1 ka aakhri imtihaan: sunna aur samajhna, alfaaz, wahid aur jama, ulte alfaaz, af'aal, jumle aur likhna. Aaram se karein. Kitaab 1 mukammal karne par mubarak ho!
intro.ar: الاخْتِبارُ النِّهائِيُّ لِلْكِتابِ الأَوَّلِ كُلِّهِ: الفَهْمُ وَالاسْتِماعُ، وَالمُفْرَداتُ، وَالمُفْرَدُ وَالجَمْعُ، وَالأَضْدادُ، وَالأَفْعالُ، وَالجُمَلُ، وَالكِتابَةُ. خُذْ وَقْتَكَ. أَحْسَنْتَ إِذْ وَصَلْتَ إِلى نِهايَةِ الكِتابِ الأَوَّلِ!

q.en: Which is a part of the body?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz jism ka hissa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ عُضْوٌ مِنْ أَعْضاءِ الجِسْمِ؟
